description: The factorial-base digits of n, from the highest place down through the 0! place, comma-separated. The last digit is always 0. 0 is "0", 5 is "2,1,0", 23 is "3,2,1,0", and 463 is "3,4,1,0,1,0". n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, length, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic
